column1: How many new police officers are being recruited?
column2: 50,000 constables: applications opened 15 December 2025 and closed 25 January 2026.
column3: More police on the ground in our communities.

column1: What is the Smart School Protection Strategy?
column2: Launched 11 February 2026 with the NSCDC: panic alerts, rapid response and command centres for schools. 156,000 schools have been geolocated on the School Safety Portal.
column3: Parents can send children to school with more confidence.

column1: What did NIMASA report about piracy in Nigerian waters in 2025?
column2: Zero piracy incidents in 2025 (agency-reported), credited to the Deep Blue maritime security project.
column3: Safer waters protect fishermen, shipping and oil production.

column1: What new rules did the police get in 2026?
column2: The Nigeria Police Regulations (Amendment) 2026, launched 16 April 2026, to strengthen professionalism, discipline and accountability.
The President's state police amendment passed the National Assembly in 2026, and at least 28 state assemblies have approved it, more than the 24 needed.
column3: Local police who know local terrain.

column1: How many forest guards have been trained?
column2: Over 7,000 graduated in December 2025, with more approved for states such as Katsina, Kaduna and Oyo in 2026.
column3: Taking the fight to kidnappers hiding in the forests.
